-- Verify Anna in Appcast slot 6
SELECT s.companyName, m.timeSlot, m.attendeeNumber, m.attendeeId, m.matchScore
FROM meetings m JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE s.companyName = 'Appcast' AND m.timeSlot = 6 AND m.isVisible = 1;
